description: This Java class 'DittoMetrics' provides static factory methods to create various metrics instruments such as timers, counters, gauges, and histograms for the Ditto project. It encapsulates the creation logic and references external metric instrument classes.

classes.name: DittoMetrics
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods to create metric instruments such as timers, counters, gauges, and histograms for the Ditto project.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates a new timer object for a metric with the specified name using DefaultTimerBuilder.

methods.name: expiringTimer
methods.description: Creates an ExpiringTimerBuilder to customize a timer before starting.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Creates a Counter with the specified name.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Creates a Counter with the specified name and tags.

methods.name: gauge
methods.description: Creates a Gauge with the specified name.

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: Creates a Histogram with the specified name.
